product_one_liner.value: Smallest.ai provides enterprises and developers with real-time voice-AI infrastructure, combining hosted voice agents with APIs for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speech-to-speech, and language models.
product_one_liner.notes: The documentation describes hosted agents for phone, web, or mobile use and model APIs covering speech-to-text, text-to-speech, speech-to-speech, and LLMs, supporting the stated product and developer/enterprise audience.

pricing_page.notes: Smallest.ai has public model-pricing and voice-agent-pricing pages, so the answer is true.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Smallest.ai’s customer-story pages identify Pocket and Kogta as customers. | named_customers.0: The customer story names Pocket. | named_customers.1: The customer story names Kogta.

employee_band.notes: The Smallest.ai people profile reports 105 total employees, which falls in the 101-200 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Smallest.ai company profile identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, California. | hq_country: The company profile places Smallest.ai in San Francisco, California, US, establishing the country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The Smallest.ai LinkedIn company profile states it was founded in 2023.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes an engineering-focused article on TTS inference and hardware co-optimization; the author profile identifies Ranjith M S as a Senior AI Inference Performance Engineer and lists that article. A separate post on Smallest’s Electron V2 language model is attributed to Akshat Mandloi, whose profile identifies him as the company CTO leading research and engineering. These provide at least two technical posts by engineering staff.

public_docs.notes: The public Smallest AI documentation site has product overviews, voice-agent and model guides, and API-reference material across multiple sections, satisfying the several-articles requirement.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current careers board lists three open roles—Senior SDET, Software Engineer - Systems and Reliability, and Manager - Finance and Accounts—and none has an AI/ML/data-science title matching the specified categories.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (for LLM inference for specific features, tooling, and evaluation pipelines)
model_provider.notes: Smallest.ai’s trust-center subprocessor table names OpenAI and specifies LLM inference for specific feature, tooling, or evaluation-pipeline use; this supports the qualified provider answer rather than implying all product models are OpenAI models.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Smallest.ai’s careers page says it is SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA compliant; its trust-center evidence names ISO 27001:2022. These are the named public claims included; the PCI claim is not stated as PCI DSS on the cited sources. | compliance_certs.0: The careers page explicitly says Smallest.ai is SOC 2 compliant. | compliance_certs.1: The trust-center evidence explicitly names ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.2: The careers page explicitly says Smallest.ai is HIPAA compliant. | compliance_certs.3: The careers page explicitly says Smallest.ai is GDPR compliant.
